parameters.name: X-Glean-Include-Experimental
parameters.description: This endpoint is experimental, so requests must include this header set to `true`. See [How experimental APIs work](https://developers.glean.com/experimental/overview) for details.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Maximum number of limits to return. Defaults to 20; the maximum allowed is 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous list response; resend the same filters when continuing.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON-encoded array of filters. Supported fields are client_id and target_type; only EQUALS is supported and is the default operator. Values within a filter are OR'd; filters are AND'd, including repeated fields. Client IDs are opaque, case-sensitive strings, matched exactly without trimming; whitespace-only values are invalid. Client filters include organization, default-user, and user policies, but exclude aggregate agent policies without a client_id. target_type values are ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, USER, DEFAULT_AGENT, and AGENT. URL-encode the JSON array as one filters query value.

items.description: One equality filter on configured usage limits.

field.description: Field to match; client_id or target_type.

values.description: Nonblank values to match exactly; any value may match.

operator.description: Comparison operator; only EQUALS is supported.
